local_org.title: Local scratch org
local_org.description: Alias the sf-local MCP server may read and write (deploy, data, tests, permission sets).

local_org_prefixes.title: Local org alias prefixes
local_org_prefixes.description: Comma-separated alias prefixes the shared-org guard treats as local scratch orgs. Usernames ending in @example.com are always local.

shared_read_orgs.title: Shared orgs for read-only queries
shared_read_orgs.description: Comma-separated aliases the sf-shared MCP server may query with SOQL only.
